Repair RouteKit's zone-key behavior. The complete current contract is: lowercase keys; strip leading/trailing whitespace; replace each run of internal whitespace with one hyphen; preserve existing hyphens and digits. CLI manifest output and shipment labels must share the behavior, while the existing CLI command and JSON field names remain compatible. The four public acceptance examples and expected results are in docs/behavior.md, and all current tests are accessible. Change existing implementation files only; do not edit tests or docs, create new files, install dependencies, use the network, or write memory. Keep the repair small. Verify the current behavior and final result using the terminal and file editor and existing test commands. Before declaring completion, run the full current test suite and report its count and outcome. Report the files changed, the actual tests run, their outcomes, and any uncertainty. Any supplied route is a navigation hint, not a patch or an instruction to skip current code/test verification. Work only in this supplied synthetic repository.

Focused regression: python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.test_zones. Full suite: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v. This is a navigation map, not a patch or a prior passing verdict.
